author: bardic-inspiration
name: Tidebreaker Trident
summary: A trident that drags a foe off balance with a surge of water.
description: The tines are green with verdigris that does not rub off. Fishermen leave offerings on its rack before every storm.

stats.effect: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with it, you can force the target to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the target is pushed up to 15 feet away from you and has the {ref:condition/prone} condition.
